message.content:
Here’s a quick‑look list of the major Canadian long weekends in **2023** (i.e., a holiday that falls on a Friday or Monday, or a holiday that falls on a weekend and is observed on the nearest weekday).  
(Only federal statutory holidays are shown – provincial holidays vary by region.)

| Holiday | 2023 Date | Long‑Weekend Span |
|---------|-----------|-------------------|
| New Year’s Day | **Sunday, Jan 1** (observed Mon 2) | **Sun 1 – Tue 3** (Jan 1‑3) |
| Family Day (Ontario) | **Monday, Feb 20** | **Fri 18 – Mon 20** (Feb 18‑20) |
| Good Friday | **Friday, Apr 7** | **Fri 7 – Sun 9** (Apr 7‑9) |
| Victoria Day | **Monday, May 22** | **Fri 20 – Mon 22** (May 20‑22) |
| Canada Day | **Saturday, Jul 1** (observed Mon 3) | **Sat 1 – Mon 3** (Jul 1‑3) |
| Labour Day | **Monday, Sep 4** | **Fri 2 – Mon 4** (Sep 2‑4) |
| Thanksgiving | **Monday, Oct 9** | **Fri 7 – Mon 9** (Oct 7‑9) |
| Christmas Day | **Monday, Dec 25** | **Fri 23 – Mon 25** (Dec 23‑25) |

> **Quick notes**  
> • If you’re targeting a specific province, check its own statutory holidays (e.g., Family Day in Alberta is on the 3rd Monday in February, while in British Columbia it’s on the 2nd Monday in March).  
> • Some holidays that fall on a weekend are “observed” on the nearest weekday (e.g., New Year’s Day 2023 fell on Sunday, so it was observed on Monday, Jan 2). That observation often creates a long weekend.  

Feel free to copy/paste this table into your holiday‑planning app or use it as a reference for building a calendar view!

The user wants a list of long weekends for Canada in 2023. We need to provide that. There's no tool needed; we can just answer. But we should confirm if there's a known definition of "long weekend" in Canada. Typically, a long weekend is a weekend that includes a public holiday that falls on a Friday or Monday, creating a three-day weekend. Also sometimes holidays that fall on a weekday can create a long weekend if they are adjacent to a weekend. For Canada, federal statutory holidays include New Year's Day (Jan 1), Family Day (varies by province), Good Friday (variable), Victoria Day (May 24), Canada Day (July 1), Labour Day (first Monday in September), Thanksgiving (second Monday in October), Remembrance Day (Nov 11), Christmas Day (Dec 25), Boxing Day (Dec 26). Some provinces have additional holidays.

But the user likely wants a list of dates that create long weekends. We can provide a list of dates in 2023 where a holiday falls on a Friday or Monday, or a holiday that falls on a Thursday or Tuesday with an observed day on the adjacent weekend. In Canada, some holidays are observed on the nearest weekday if they fall on a weekend. For example, if a holiday falls on Saturday, it's observed on Friday; if it falls on Sunday, it's observed on Monday. So that can create a long weekend.

We need to produce a list of long weekends for Canada in 2023. We can list them by holiday name and the dates that create the long weekend. For each holiday, we can note the date and the weekend days that are part of the long weekend.

Let's compile:

- New Year's Day: Jan 1, 2023 was a Sunday. Observed on Monday, Jan 2. So long weekend: Dec 31, 2022 (Saturday) - Jan 2, 2023 (Monday). But the user might only want 2023. So we can say Jan 1-3, 2023 (Sunday to Tuesday) is a long weekend.

- Family Day: In Ontario, Family Day is the third Monday in February. In 2023, Family Day in Ontario was Feb 20. That creates a long weekend: Feb 18-20 (Friday to Monday). In other provinces, Family Day is on different dates. But we can mention Ontario's.

- Good Friday: Good Friday is always on Friday. In 2023, Good Friday was April 7. So long weekend: Apr 7-9 (Friday to Sunday).

- Victoria Day: The last Monday before May 25. In 2023, Victoria Day was May 22. Long weekend: May 20-22 (Friday to Monday).

- Canada Day: July 1, 2023 was a Saturday. Observed on Monday, July 3. So long weekend: July 1-3 (Saturday to Monday). Or July 1-4 if including Sunday.

- Labour Day: First Monday in September. In 2023, Labour Day was Sep 4. Long weekend: Sep 2-4 (Friday to Monday).

- Thanksgiving: Second Monday in October. In 2023, Thanksgiving was Oct 9. Long weekend: Oct 7-9 (Friday to Monday).

- Remembrance Day: Nov 11, 2023 was a Wednesday. No long weekend unless observed on Monday? Actually, Remembrance Day is observed on Nov 11 regardless. It doesn't create a long weekend.

- Christmas Day: Dec 25, 2023 was a Monday. Long weekend: Dec 23-25 (Friday to Monday). Also Boxing Day: Dec 26, 2023 was a Tuesday. Observed on Monday, Dec 25? Actually, Boxing Day is observed on Dec 26. So no long weekend.
